subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should native Apple widget PNG export be sponsored as a core parity feature once the macOS localization, filename bound, and signed-app proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: This is a new user-facing native capability; the merged Android counterpart supports the direction, but accepting the Apple implementation and its long-term UI surface remains a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Sponsor parity feature
options.body: Accept Apple widget export after the concrete correctness fixes and redacted iOS or macOS runtime proof are supplied.

options.title: Defer native export
options.body: Pause the Apple surface if maintainers do not want transcript widget export to become a supported native capability yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor parity feature
recommendation.body: Accept Apple widget export after the concrete correctness fixes and redacted iOS or macOS runtime proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the related merged Android implementation and authored the Apple parity proposal.
